children.text: Corinne Hadaway is a French author-illustrator based in Des Moines, Iowa. She has self-published two illustrated books, built a YouTube audience of 12,000+ artists through her Krita tutorials, and maintains an active Instagram following for the Lheeloo & Luna series. The characters have a complete visual bible — poses, expressions, and proportions — and bilingual French and Spanish editions are planned.
She is currently seeking publishing and rights partners for the Lheeloo & Luna picture-book series. A complete 30-page PDF is available for professional review above.
